description: Search Microsoft Bing — web, images, video, news and suggestions. Zero-config, no API key, no login.
long_description:
Bing Search MCP gives an AI agent access to Microsoft Bing search: web, images, video and news, plus autocomplete suggestions.

The implementation follows how the official Bing Android app works (established by APK analysis): web search calls Bing's native v7 search API — the endpoint embedded in the app (in-app it serves related queries, but its response carries the full web result set) — while images, video and news read the same server-rendered pages the app's WebView displays. No user API key, no account, no configuration file. Two details make it work: the market is pinned with mkt/setlang (without them Bing returns an empty result set), and image search is fetched the app way — a mobile user agent plus the app-style parameters — because the desktop image page only loads results with JavaScript.

## Verticals
- **Web search** — general web search with paging, total hit count and related queries, via the native v7 search API (direct destination URLs)
- **Image search** — original image URL, thumbnail, source page and title
- **Video search** — videos across YouTube, TikTok, Niconico and others, with the real watch URL, duration and view count
- **News search** — news articles with publisher and publish-time text
- **Suggest** — autocomplete candidates for web, images and videos
